## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for a caller.

## Specification and decisions

Link the reviewed specification section and relevant ADRs. A spec change needs
an RFC, rationale, conformance updates and a major spec version when breaking.

## Validation

List commands and actual results. Distinguish local checks from hosted CI.
For evaluator changes, both languages must run the same vectors directly.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] DCO sign-off is present on every commit.
- [ ] No organisation-specific content or hardcoded domain names was added.
- [ ] Engine guarantees remain mandatory; modeling choices remain declared.
- [ ] Dependencies have approval and a documented rationale.
- [ ] The applicable phase review gate has been satisfied.
